notes: Curated eval focused on multi-call objection clustering, coverage discipline, and the boundary with the governed response library. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Analyze these 24 discovery and demo calls to find recurring buyer objections by persona and stage. Show the denominator, account breadth, evidence confidence, and the two enablement actions that deserve priority.

Our managers keep saying implementation capacity is blocking deals. Check the supplied call set, separate explicit buyer language from seller interpretation, and tell me whether the pattern is broad enough to act on.
Turn this month of call notes into an evidence-backed objection brief. Some records have transcripts and others only summaries, so make coverage and source quality visible.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Coach this one discovery call and give the rep two behaviors to practice before the next meeting.
Build the approved objection-response library, including proof, do-not-say guidance, lifecycle ownership, and escalation rules.
Write the final governed objection library from these call themes, with approved responses and status labels.
Synthesize buyer interviews and closed-deal evidence to explain why we won or lost across segments.

output_structure_checks.name: call-insights-scope-and-coverage
output_structure_checks.description: Includes the decision question, inclusion rules, eligible and usable calls, denominators, unique-account and rep breadth, source quality, and material coverage gaps.

output_structure_checks.name: call-insights-evidence-separation
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps buyer evidence, analyst interpretation, root-cause hypotheses, observed consequences, and recommendations distinct and traceable.

output_structure_checks.name: call-insights-library-boundary
output_structure_checks.description: Does not publish approved objection-response language or turn sparse or uneven evidence into organization-wide prevalence or individual performance conclusions.

output_structure_checks.name: call-insights-to-objections-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Links recommendations to the likely cause: messaging or practice for communication gaps, a product or process owner for capability or workflow gaps, and research where cause remains uncertain.

task_scenarios.prompt: Analyze calls.json using scope.md. Cluster recurring objections, quantify frequency and independent-account breadth, attach short representative evidence, and recommend no more than two enablement actions. Keep observation, interpretation, and recommendation separate, and make weak coverage visible.

assertions.name: call-insights-seven-record-scope
assertions.description: Uses exactly seven in-scope records, excludes the enterprise procurement call, and weights transcript evidence above the summary-only record.

assertions.name: call-insights-breadth-and-uncertainty
assertions.description: Reports call frequency and independent-account or rep breadth, keeps the isolated security concern visible without calling it recurring, and preserves the unknown outcome.

assertions.name: call-insights-no-governed-publication
assertions.description: Does not invent deal outcomes, make rep-level performance claims, or publish a governed objection library from this analysis.
